purpose: Determine whether the already-qualified conservative LayeredMFP interface construction has a simple, explicit and cheap hydraulic core envelope in which a frozen lookup representation can meet the existing accuracy rules, while all states outside that envelope are classified fail-closed rather than extrapolated or silently accepted.
why_c5a_is_not_carried_forward: The frozen C5a mixed-state candidate failed the existing diagnostic thresholds by wide margins on both tested blocker classes and is therefore not a C6a admission candidate.

revealed_sets_allowed: C3b off-grid dry-to-wet holdout now treated only as revealed characterization data
characterization_data.new_characterization_sampling: Allowed only with a fixed recorded seed and must be marked revealed immediately after execution. It cannot serve as C6b qualification evidence.

characterization_outputs: diagnostic-threshold violation count among admitted cases
p90 p99 and maximum relative flux error among admitted active cases
sign mismatch count among admitted cases
representation bytes and offline oracle cost
Pareto set of simple classifiers only; no qualified classifier claim
selection_rule: C6a may nominate at most one provider plus one simple axis-aligned classifier for C6b. A nominee must have zero sign mismatches, zero coverage failures, zero known diagnostic-threshold violations in admitted revealed cases, nonzero admitted coverage in both blocker materials, and a lower shared immutable table cost than an always-use-FullRichards strategy can plausibly justify only as a performance candidate. No numerical threshold may be modified after nomination.
c6b_holdout_rule: Any C6a nominee requires a separately precommitted unseen C6b holdout with a new random seed, off-grid states, the full available F-LMFP09 hydraulic fixture set and both flow directions. The exact provider, classifier features, classifier thresholds and existing accuracy rules must be frozen before that holdout is generated.
out_of_envelope_semantics: OUT_OF_LAYEREDMFP_ADMITTED_ENVELOPE is an explicit diagnostic classification, not a numerical failure and not permission to extrapolate. Runtime fallback policy remains outside this characterization gate and must preserve mass, transactionality and reference-mode truthfulness.
